name: Tern 1.4.0
body:
## Highlights

Tern can now resume an interrupted upload instead of starting the file again. A large archive that stopped at 90% finishes in seconds on the next run. Thanks @jun-tanaka for the long weekend of testing on a flaky connection.

```bash
tern sync --resume
```

## What's changed

- Resume interrupted multipart uploads with `--resume` by @mira-okafor in #412
- `tern plan` prints the size of each change, not just its name by @lena-vogt in #418
- Fix a crash when the remote folder name has a trailing dot by @jun-tanaka in #421
- Update the documentation for retries (see the [configuration guide](https://example.com/tern/guides/configuration))

> [!NOTE]
> Resuming needs a remote that supports multipart uploads. Tern falls back to a full upload on the others and says so in the plan.

Full comparison: https://github.com/tern-cli/tern/compare/v1.3.2...v1.4.0

name: Tern 1.3.2
body:
## What's changed

- Fix `.ternignore` patterns that start with `!` being ignored when they follow a directory rule by @jun-tanaka in #405
- Exit with code 4, not 1, when the credentials are rejected, so a scheduler can tell it from a network error by @lena-vogt in #407

Full comparison: https://github.com/tern-cli/tern/compare/v1.3.1...v1.3.2

name: Tern 1.3.0
body:
## Highlights

Every command can print JSON with `--json`, so a script can read the result without parsing text.

```bash
tern plan --json | jq '.changes | length'
```

## What's changed

- Add `--json` to `init`, `plan`, `sync` and `status` by @lena-vogt in #371
- Add the `status` command, which lists what differs without reading file contents by @mira-okafor in #380
- Document every exit code in the reference by @jun-tanaka in #384

### Upgrade notes

- [x] Scripts that parse the text output keep working
- [ ] The text output of `plan` will change in 2.0: prefer `--json`

name: Tern 1.2.1
body: - Fix a deadlock when the bucket answers slowly during a `sync` of more than 10,000 files by @jun-tanaka in #355

name: Tern 1.2.0
body:
## What's changed

- Add retries with backoff, configured with `retries` in `tern.yml` by @mira-okafor in #330
- Add `tern init --template` for a ready-made `.ternignore` by @lena-vogt in #339
- Faster plans on folders with many small files by @jun-tanaka in #346

Thanks to everyone who reported slow plans in #320.

name: Tern 1.1.0
body:
## What's changed

- Add `--dry-run` to `sync`, which lists every change and makes none by @lena-vogt in #301
- Read the remote from `TERN_REMOTE` when it is not in the configuration by @jun-tanaka in #305

name: Tern 1.0.0
body:
The first stable release. The commands, the configuration file and the exit codes are now covered by semantic versioning.

## Highlights

- `init`, `plan`, `sync` and `status` with a stable output
- A configuration file, `tern.yml`, next to the folder or in your home directory
- Linux, macOS and Windows archives, each with a checksum

Thank you to the 14 people who tried the release candidates.

name: Tern 1.0.0-rc.2
body:
Second release candidate. No new features: only the fixes below.

- Fix the path separator in the plan on Windows by @jun-tanaka in #262
- Fix a typo in the `--help` text of `sync` by @lena-vogt in #266

name: Tern 1.0.0-rc.1
body: First release candidate for 1.0. Please try it and report what you find in #250.

name: Tern 0.9.0
body:
- Add checksums to the plan so a changed file with the same size is not skipped by @jun-tanaka in #231
- Breaking: the configuration key `bucket` is now `remote`; Tern still reads the old name and warns
